svg.title: Database schema v13 (one file evedm.sqlite3, WAL, on the /app/data volume)

g.text: Database schema v13 (one file evedm.sqlite3, WAL, on the /app/data volume)
alliance_id : INTEGER (read from ESI; the alliance gate)
posted : 0 pending | 1 posted | 2 not posted (Discord, v11)
event_key : TEXT «PK» (type : structure or system : time)
message_id : TEXT (Discord message, edited for more recipients)
seen_at : REAL (the character's structure search found the gate)
name, owner_id, owner_name, system_id, type_id, type_name
source : EVE Ref | Local index | Adam4EVE (v13)
seen_at : REAL (a character has an asset there; picks the token)
